topic.source_contract: School-place planning areas, pupil yield, capacity forecasts, developer contributions, land, funding, delivery and opening evidence

facts.guidance: education infrastructure and developer contributions for housing growth
facts.guard: formula output is not a site-specific obligation

facts.planning_areas: 2026 guidance for structuring pupil planning areas
facts.guard: planning-area data is not a guaranteed school place

facts.forecast: SCAP 2026 records capacity, forecasts and housing-developer-funded places
facts.guard: forecast places are not delivered places

facts.current: 2025 scorecards published 25 June 2026 include need, delivery, forecast accuracy and cost
facts.guard: national cost data is not an agreed contribution

facts.tests: section 106 obligations must be necessary, directly related and fairly and reasonably related in scale and kind
facts.guard: policy expectation is not an executed obligation

scope_guards: A pupil-yield formula is not treated as a site-specific forecast without scheme inputs.
A planning-area shortfall is not treated as absence of capacity at every school.
A forecast school place is not treated as built and available capacity.
Basic-need or other public funding is not treated as secured developer mitigation.
A policy contribution is not treated as an executed section 106 obligation.
Land identification is not treated as transferred, serviced and deliverable school land.
A contribution payment is not treated as completed school expansion or opening.
No score or promotion is written without exact scheme yield, capacity, obligation, land, funding, programme, construction and opening evidence.
